title: Li Shufu, who started schools before making cars: The AI era will give rise to a new generation of universities
excerpt: At the 2026 Xinwei Education Forum, Li Shufu, Chairman of Geely Holding Group, made a bold judgment: the talent cultivation system of traditional universities c
content_html:
At the 2026 Xinwei Education Forum, Li Shufu, Chairman of Geely Holding Group, made a bold judgment: the talent cultivation system of traditional universities can no longer keep up with the demands of the AI era, and “the AI era will inevitably give rise to a group of new-type universities that match this era.”

Before making cars, build schools first

Behind this statement is Geely’s long-standing tradition. Li Shufu reiterated the idea of being “both an enterprise and a school”: in the early days of Geely’s automobile industry venture, it relied on Geely Technician College and Geely Technical School—first came talent and skilled technicians and workers, and only then came the cars. Today, Geely has formed a multi-level education system ranging from secondary and higher vocational education to undergraduate and graduate education, including Geely University, Sanya University, Xiangtan Institute of Technology, and other schools.

Will universities repeat the old path of department stores?

He explained his concern about the form of universities with a blunt analogy: traditional universities are like traditional department stores and supermarkets, while universities born in the AI era are like Alibaba, Tencent, JD.com, and ByteDance. Back then, Shanghai No. 1 Department Store and Hangzhou Jiefang Road Department Store were incredibly glorious, but today they have been squeezed into a corner by e-commerce—“completely different starting points, completely different results.” Under the new model, students can arrange their learning pace according to their own preferences and actual circumstances.

He also cautioned against over-mystifying AI: knowledge in a database does not mean everyone has mastered it, and no matter how smart a large language model is, it does not mean everyone naturally becomes smarter. Training methods and learning content must keep pace with the progress of the times. Facing the dual challenges of new globalization and geopolitics, Geely will work with its schools to expand its training scale globally, enroll undergraduate, master’s, and doctoral students, and cultivate new-type globalized talent.
